note: Business queries per invocation on the tx the AnalyticsService runs (SET LOCAL + BEGIN/SAVEPOINT/RELEASE/COMMIT filtered by the reused 8-1a CountingDBTX). Counting boundary = the tx the service runs on, NOT the pool (W1). SIZE-INVARIANT: count(small) == count(large) — proven O(1)-in-rows. 8-2a proofs in TestAnalyticsClass_QueryCount_DetectsSyntheticNPlus1_ATDD; 8-3a proofs in TestStudentPerf_QueryCount_SizeInvariant_BothEndpoints_ATDD (small=1 skill/2 grades/1 week vs large=4 skills/40 grades/12 gapped weeks, BOTH endpoints) + TestStudentPerf_QueryCount_DetectsSyntheticNPlus1_ATDD (4 per-axis probes: per-skill band loop / per-week densify / comments unnest / answer_errors unnest). Ceilings are TIGHT (the exact composed set) so any future per-row fan-out trips the gate. 8-3a folds the center tz into GetStudentForAnalytics (no separate GetCenterTimezone), keeping the student budget at 6.
